# Build guide

From a pile of parts to a robot standing on its own. Work through the steps in order.

| Step | |
|---|---|
| [01 Printing](01_printing.md) | Print settings, orientation, critical parts |
| [02 Servo setup](02_servo_setup.md) | IDs, ID map, zero and offset calibration. Read this one carefully |
| [03 Legs](03_legs.md) | Assembling each leg, then the hips and torso |
| [04 Electronics](04_electronics.md) | PCB, wiring, IMU mounting and orientation |
| [05 Software](05_software.md) | Jetson setup, first power-on, safe standing test |
| [06 Troubleshooting](06_troubleshooting.md) | Problems hit during the build and how they were fixed |

Before you start, have everything in [`bom/bom.csv`](../../bom/bom.csv) and
[`bom/printed_parts.csv`](../../bom/printed_parts.csv). Photos for these pages go in [`img/`](img/), named
by step: `03_left_thigh_servo.jpg`.
